coordinate_convention: zero-based scan_line and detector_column; no 3D or cross-camera correspondence
sampling: even scan lines AND even columns inside assistant-reviewed visible-tissue polygons
region_identity: R1-R5 are scan-order specimen-region candidates; not operator-verified P1-P5 or whole-plant segmentation
patch_method: Selected from recorded three-band display before examining index values; tissue/organ and ownership remain review candidates
